summary: Stack of collapsible sections made of violet-accordion-item children.

usage.text: The expand-mode attribute is multi (default) or single. In single mode, opening an item collapses the others, and only the first item marked expanded stays open when items are added.
A change event fires on user toggles with detail { item, expanded }, where item is the violet-accordion-item element. Setting expanded on an item from script fires nothing and collapses no siblings.

Arrow keys, Home and End are captured for any keydown inside an item, panel content included, and move focus between headers. Text inputs and other arrow-key controls placed in a panel lose those keys.
